title: Intent-conditioned and Non-toxic Counterspeech Generation using Multi-Task Instruction Tuning with RLAIF

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to generate contextually relevant, non-toxic counterspeech and identify implied stereotypes against hate speech targeting Muslims and Jews. Assessed using automated metrics (Pro-Con stance, Argument Quality, Toxicity) and multidimensional human evaluation.

Evaluating the generation of intent-conditioned counterspeech and auxiliary explanations (e.g., power dynamics, cognitive reactions) in response to hate speech targeting women, measured by automated text quality and effectiveness metrics as well as human evaluation.

Measuring the model's effectiveness in countering hate speech directed at the LGBTQ+ community by evaluating the argumentative quality, contextual relevance, and non-toxicity of the generated responses.

Evaluating the system's capacity to recognize target groups and generate persuasive, logically structured counterspeech against hate speech targeting Asian people and People of Color (POC), using reinforcement learning reward models and human preference ratings.

Assessing the model's performance in mitigating xenophobic hate speech targeting immigrants and refugees. The evaluation relies on stance classifiers, toxicity scores, and human judgments of the grammatical adequacy and argumentative effectiveness of the counterspeech.

Evaluating the model's counterspeech generation capabilities in response to hate speech targeting disabled individuals, utilizing automated safety and quality metrics alongside human-evaluated category accuracy.
